headline: Ya es de los huracanes más largos de la historia
content: Hurricane Dorian takes strength The number of deaths could be shocking. The hurricane has caused devastating effects especially along the east coast of the United States, specifically in North Carolina and South Carolina states. However, its most destructive impacts were felt in the Bahamas where the death toll currently stands at 43 and search and rescue operations continue. With barely any water and food supplies left, electricity levels have dropped due to damage across the islands.

headline: Trump revela capacidad de espionaje de su país
content: President Donald Trump shared on Twitter what he claims was taken by a Washington satellite showing a missile launch site in Iran. His intention seemed to mock Tehran after their own space mission failed. Nevertheless, President Trump may have compromised national security secrets since the photograph in question is highly confidential but also shows extraordinary clarity suggesting U.S. true spying capabilities might exceed expectations held by rival powers.
